# Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2

A third-party document, vendored as a record of the accessibility rules BirdView adopts.
**Not covered by BirdView's Apache 2.0 license.** It is distributed under the W3C Document
License, which permits copying it unmodified with the notice below.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Files** | `REC-WCAG22-20241212.html` |
| **Origin** | <https://www.w3.org/TR/2024/REC-WCAG22-20241212/> |
| **Status of the document** | W3C Recommendation, 12 December 2024 |
| **Owner** | World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) |
| **License** | [W3C Document License](https://www.w3.org/copyright/document-license-2023/) |
| **Modifications** | **None.** The file is byte-identical to what the origin served. The license grants no right to modify the document, so unlike the iNaturalist copies its `<script>` and `<link>` elements are left in place; opening it in a browser loads W3C's stylesheet and script. |
| **Used for** | Nothing at runtime. BirdView's requirements quote it, and the copy lets a reader check every quotation against the exact text it came from. |
